entries.toelichting: Unique lexeme. 'Mountain' standard.
Mount Hor (death-place of Aaron Num 20:22, Num 33); also northern border-mountain Num 34:7; concordantly transliterated as place-name.
Proper noun, place where eastern-tribes were carried away; 1Chr 5:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hara.
Hapax Eze 43:15 burnt-offering-altar-top; compound har-El mountain-of-God or fire-hearth.
Root hrg. 'Slay' standard; distinguished from mut (dying-process, H4191).
Mass-murder or slaughter-work in judgment (Esth 9:5; Isa 27:7; 30:25; Prov 24:11; Zech 11:4,7). Hyphenated to distinguish slaughter-killing-aspect from H2028 haregah and H7524 retsach 'murder'.
Place of death-slaughter as judgment-image (Jer 7:32; 12:3; 19:6; Zech 11:4,7). Hyphenated to distinguish slaughter-place-aspect from H2027 hereg and H2873 tavach.
Qal: be impregnated, conceive; the hyphenated English marks physical aspect.
Judg-behold-you-are-barren-you-shall-conceive-and-bear-a-son and Judg-you-shall-conceive-and-bear-a-son (Judg 13:5,7). Hyphenated.
Active-adjective 'with-child' (Gen 16:11, 38:24-25, Ex 21:22, Judg 13:5,7, 1Sam 4:19, 2Sam 11:5, 2Kgs 8:12, 15:16, Isa 7:14, 26:17, Jer 20:17, 31:8, Hos 13:16, Amos 1:13); concordantly 'pregnant'.
Second-sense harah; pregnant-women Samaria-cleaved-through; Hos 13:16.
Aramaic for visions-thoughts on bed; Dan 4:5.
Gen-multiply-conception-and-sorrow and Hos-from-bearing-and-from-womb-and-from-conception and Ruth-LORD-gave-conception (Gen 3:16; Hos 9:11; Ruth 4:13). Hyphenated.
Patronym-clan David's-warrior Shammoth; 1Chr 11:27; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hararite.
David's-fallen-tabernacle-ruins to restore; Amos 9:11.
Zion's-ruins-shall-be-too-narrow for returnees; Isa 49:19.
Proper noun, king of Gezer; Josh 10:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Horam.
Proper noun, father of Aharhel-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Harum.
Proper noun, place where people-were cast away; Amos 4:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Harmon.
Brother of Abram, father of Lot (Gen 11:26,27,28,29,31; 1Chr 2:46; 23:9). English convention: Haran.
Qal: pull down, overthrow, destroy; concordantly 'break-down'.
Proper noun ('destruction-city') Egypt-city; Isa 19:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Heres.
Poetic/extended noun-form of har (H2022); distributes in Ps, Song, prophets (Ps 30:8, 87:1, 133:3); concordantly identical 'mountain' - morphological variant does not break concordance.
Mountain-dweller-family of David's mighty men (2Sam 23:11,33; 1Chr 11:34,35). Gentilic. 'Mountain-dweller'.
Proper noun, David's-warrior Gizonite; 1Chr 11:34; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Hashem.
Wait-for-announcement-from-exile; Eze 24:26.
Like-melt-work-silver in furnace; Eze 22:22.
Persian-eunuch messenger between Esther and Mordecai (Esth 4:5,6,9,10). English convention: Hathach. 'Verily-decided'.
Piel; Elijah mocks Baal-prophets ('he is musing, on a journey...'); 1Kgs 18:27.

Second homonym distinguished from hatal-I; Piel/Pual: mockingly-deceive-by-false-promises-or-words distinguished from ramah (deceive) and natal (defraud) by mockery-aspect (Gen 31:7 Jacob-to-Laban, Ex 8:29, Judg 16:10,13,15, Job 13:9, Isa 44:20, Jer 9:5).
Mock-figures surround Job; Job 17:2.
Polel; David's-enemies storm-against me; Ps 62:3.
Proper noun trading-people with Tyre; Eze 27:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vedan.
Proper noun, place in war-book; Num 21:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vaheb.
Metal hook/peg from which tabernacle-curtains hang; concordantly 'hook'.
Guilty's-path is deviating-strange; Prov 21:8.
Proper noun, tenth son of Haman; Esth 9:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vajezatha.
Aramaising for yeled; Gen 11:30.
Proper noun, son of Bani who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:36; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vaniah.
Proper noun, father of Nahbi; Num 13:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vophsi.
Proper noun, son of Samuel; 1Chr 6:28; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Vashni.
Queen of Ahasuerus who-refused to-appear-before-his-guests and-was-deposed in favour-of Esther (Esth 1:9,11-12,15-17,19, 2:1,4,17). English convention: Vashti.
Steppe-wolf as image of rapacity (Gen 49:27; Isa 11:6; 65:25; Jer 5:6; Eze 22:27; Hab 1:8; Zeph 3:3). English convention: wolf.
Midianite prince killed at the Wolf-press (Judg 7:25; 8:3; Ps 83:12). 'Wolf'. English convention: Zeeb.
Demonstrative feminine, counterpart of zeh (H2088). 'This' identical to masculine; context disambiguates.
Qal; lavish-gift-hand-over; Gen 30:20.
Result of zavad; Gen 30:20.
Several persons of the same name: Judah-descent, Ephraimite, murderer of Joash (1Chr 2:36,37; 7:21; 11:41; 2Chr 24:26; Ezra 10:27,33,43). From zavad 'bestow'. English convention: Zabad.
Judah-ancestor of Achan and other persons (Josh 7:1,17,18; 1Chr 8:19; 27:27; Neh 11:17). 'My-gift'. English convention: Zabdi.
1Chr-the-sons-of-Gershon-Libni-his-son-Jahath-his-son-Zimmah-his-son and 1Chr-Joah-the-son-of-Zimmah (1Chr 6:20,42). Hyphenated.
Several-persons: Benjamite-archer who-came-to-David in-Ziklag (1Chr 12:7); Korahite gatekeeper, judge under Jehoshaphat, post-exilic priest. English convention: Zebadiah. 'YHWH-has-bestowed'.
YHWH-whistles-for-fly-of-Egypt against Judah; Isa 7:18.
Proper noun, priest of Solomon son of Nathan; 1Kgs 4:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zabud.
Proper noun, return with Ezra (not Solomon's-priest H2071); Ezra 8:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zabud.
Exalted divine dwelling-house in heavens (1Kgs 8:13; 2Chr 6:2; Isa 63:15; Hab 3:11; Ps 49:15). Hyphenated to distinguish exalted-house-aspect from H4583 ma'on 'dwelling'; family with H2082 zaval.
Proper noun (son/tribe of Israel); concordantly transliterated.
Zebulonite tribe-member at census and army-organisation (Num 26:27; Judg 12:11,12). English convention: Zebulonite. Family-with H2074 Zevulun (already assigned); tribal-adjective.
Root zbh. 'Sacrifice' preserves the offer-slaughter-action; derived zevach (H2077).

Root zbh (slaughter, sacrifice, H2076). Zevach = slaughtered offering. 'Slaughter-offering' preserves the root-relation with the slaughter-action; 'sacrifice' is broader, 'meal-offering' is context-splinter.
Midianite king defeated by Gideon (Judg 8:5-21, Ps 83:12); concordantly transliterated. Homonym with zevach 'slaughter-offering' (H2077) distinguished by proper-noun-status.
Proper noun, son of Bebai who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:28; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zabbai.
2K-and-his-mother's-name-was-Zebudah-a-daughter-of-Pedaiah-of-Rumah (2K 23:36). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, son of Nebo who took foreign-wife; Ezra 10:43; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zebina.
Qal; with-me-cause-to-dwell; Zebulun-name-explanation; Gen 30:20.
Governor of Abimelech in Shechem (Judg 9:28,30,36,38,41). 'Exalted-dwelling'. English convention: Zebul.
Aramaic buy-acquire-for-self (Dan 2:8 buy-time); cognate Hebrew √zvn absent.
Skin-part of grape Nazirite-prohibition; Num 6:4.
From zud 'swell-boil'. Person-designation of the insolent (Ps 119:21,51,69; Mal 3:15). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2087 zadon 'insolence' (abstract).

Arrogant-deliberate-sin against better knowing (Deut 17:12 'who acts with zadon', 1Sam 17:28 Eliab's reproach to David, Prov 11:2 shame-follows, 13:10 strife-from, 21:24, Jer 49:16 Edom, 50:29,31-32 Babel).
Demonstrative masculine. Female parallel zot (H2063). 'This' is the standard translation.
Demonstrative pronoun feminine singular (Judg 18:4; 1Kgs 14:5; 2Kgs 6:19; Eze 40:45; Ps 132:14). Hyphenated to preserve feminine-variant-aspect; family with H2063 zoth 'this' (standard).
Unique lexeme. Metal. 'Gold' standard.
Piel; soul-loathes-bread in sickness; Job 33:20.
Proper noun, son of Rehoboam + Mahalath; 2Chr 11:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zaham.
First-sense zahar; wise-shine like-firmament; Dan 12:3.
Hiphil: instruct someone by warning; distinguished from zahar I 'shine'; concordantly 'warn'.
Aramaic be-cautious (Ezra 4:22 royal-decree-attentively); cognate Hebrew √zhr.

Brightness or radiating clarity - in Ezekiel 8:2 (looked like the appearance of fire, like the appearance of brightness) and Daniel 12:3 (they shall shine as the brightness of the firmament); heavenly light.
Hapax-form; 'for-this-mocking' among nations; Hos 7:16.
Demonstrative/relative pron (poetic, especially Psalms): this, which; the hyphenated English marks relative-function.
1K-in-the-month-Ziv-which-is-the-second-month-he-began-to-build-the-house-of-the-LORD and 1K-in-the-fourth-year-was-the-house-of-the-LORD-founded-in-the-month-Ziv (1K 6:1,37). Hyphenated.
Qal: stream, flow forth; used for milk and honey, and for body-discharges; concordantly 'flow'.
From √zuv (flow); abnormal body-outflow (Lev 15), makes unclean; concordantly 'discharge'.
Qal/Hiphil: deliberately-defiantly-act against-authority distinguished from ga'ah (be-haughty) and anaph (be-angry) by presumption-aspect; originally 'boil/seethe' metaphorically-used.
Aramaic Hifel-infinitive; spirit-Nebuchadnezzar defied; Dan 5:20.
Proper noun people defeated by Chedorlaomer; Gen 14:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zuzim.
Proper noun, son of Ishi-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zoheth.

Corner-pillar or cornerstone as adornment of buildings - in Psalm 144:12 (our daughters as corner-pillars carved after the similitude of a palace) and Zechariah 9:15 (they shall be filled like the basins).

Squander or lightly throw out - in Isaiah 46:6 (they squander gold out of the bag and weigh silver in the balance) and Lamentations 1:8 (therefore she has become unclean; all that honoured her despise her).
Separating preposition: except, with the exception of; concordantly 'besides'.
Hofal-participle; well-fed-horses-listening; Jer 5:8.
Aramaic Hithpeel; all-flesh-fed by Nebuchadnezzar-tree; Dan 4:12.
Tremble and quake from fear - in Esther 5:9 (he did not stand up nor move for him) and Ecclesiastes 12:3 (in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble); the motion of dismay before God.
Aramaic-tremble of peoples before God-of-Daniel (Dan 5:19; 6:27). Hyphenated to distinguish tremble-shake-aramaic-aspect from H7493 ra'ash 'tremble' (already assigned) and H2729 charad.
Great shudder which befalls peoples (Deut 28:25; 2Chr 29:8; Jer 15:4; 24:9; 29:18; 34:17; Eze 23:46). Hyphenated; family with H2112 zua-aramaic 'tremble-aramaic'.
Qal: be strange/different, deviate; partic. zar = stranger/unauthorised; root-form 'be-strange'.
Second-sense zur; Job's-breath became strange to his wife; Job 19:17.

Gideon-wring-dew-out-of-fleece and Job-egg-crushing and Isaiah-wound-press-out (Judg 6:38; Job 39:15; Isa 1:6). Hyphenated to distinguish press-out-wring-out-aspect from homonym H2114 zur 'be-strange'.
What-comes-out-of-eggs-into-adder; Isa 59:5.
Proper noun, son of Jonathan-Jerahmeel-branch; 1Chr 2:33; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zaza.
Ex-that-the-breastplate-be-not-loosed-from-the-ephod and Ex-so-shall-the-breastplate-not-be-loosed (Ex 28:28; 39:21). Hyphenated to distinguish be-loosed-shift-aspect from other-motion-terms.
Deut-with-poison-of-things-crawling-in-dust and Job-I-was-afraid-and-I-shrank (Deut 32:24; Job 32:6 cf). Hyphenated.
Second-sense zachal; Elihu held himself back from awe for age; Job 32:6.
Proper noun ('serpent-stone') Adonijah-feast-place; 1Kgs 1:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: En-rogel/Zoheleth.
Proud-band-waters-would have-swallowed-us; Ps 124:5.
Aramaic-equivalent for radiance of royal countenance (Dan 2:31; 4:33; 5:6,9,10; 7:28). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H2099 ziv 'splendour-bloom'.
God: 'all that moves on fields is mine'; Ps 50:11.
Second-sense ziz; refresh with Zion's-abundance-breast; Isa 66:11.

1Chr-and-Joel-and-Jehu-the-son-of-Joshibiah-and-Eljoenai-and-Jaakobah-and-Jeshohaiah-and-Asaiah-and-Adiel-and-Jesimiel-and-Benaiah-and-Ziza and 2Chr-and-Ziza-the-second-and-Shelomith (1Chr 4:37; 2Chr 11:20). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, Levi tribe-head variant Zina; 1Chr 23:11; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zizah.
Proper noun, Levi tribe-head Gershon-branch; 1Chr 23:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zina.
Proper noun, Gad tribe-head; 1Chr 5:13; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zia.
Place-name in Judah-wilderness where David-hid from Saul (Josh 15:24,55, 1Sam 23:14-15,24, 26:1-2 Ziphites-betray David to-Saul); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Jehallelel-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ziphah.

1S-the-Ziphites-came-up-to-Saul-to-Gibeah-saying-does-not-David-hide-himself-with-us and Ps-when-the-Ziphites-came-and-said-to-Saul-does-not-David-hide-himself-with-us (1S 23:19; Ps 54-title). Hyphenated.
Ps-burning-arrows-of-God's-judgment and Prov-fool-throwing-fire-brands and Isa-burning-iron-fetters (Ps 7:14; Prov 26:18; Isa 50:11). Hyphenated.
Iron-bonds for prisoners and kings (Ps 149:8; Isa 45:14; Nah 3:10; Job 36:8). Hyphenated to distinguish chains-fetters-aspect from homonym H2131a ziqq-I 'fire-arrow-spark' (already assigned).
Olea europaea, tree and fruit; olive-oil central in cult and household; concordantly 'olive'.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Becher; 1Chr 7:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zethan.
Adjective of pure-unmixed quality; pure olive-oil for menorah (Ex 27:20, Lev 24:2), pure incense (Ex 30:34, Lev 24:7), moral unmixedness (Job 8:6, 11:4, 15:15 heavens not zakh, 16:17, 25:5).
Morally transparent-pure-be (Job 15:14; 25:4; Ps 51:6; 73:13; 119:9; Prov 20:9; Isa 1:16; Mic 6:11). Hyphenated to distinguish transparent-pure from H2891 taher 'be-clean' (cultic-ritual).
Aramaic for innocence-found before God; Dan 6:22.
Wisdom not-comparable with gold-and-glass; Job 28:17.
Men-of-people called-together for feast (Ex 23:17; 34:23; Deut 16:16; 20:13). Hyphenated to distinguish male-circle-aspect from H2145 zakhar 'male' and H376 ish 'man'.
Several-persons in-Second-temple-time and-David-time: father-of-Shammua spy-of-Reuben (Num 13:4); Merarite-Levite (1Chr 24:27); Asaphite-singer (1Chr 25:2,10; Neh 12:35); covenant-signer (Neh 10:12).
Head of a family of 760 returnees with Zerubbabel - Ezra 2:9, Nehemiah 7:14.
Pure-clean be of heart, wool or angels (Job 15:15; 25:5; Lam 4:7; Job 9:30). Hyphenated to distinguish pure-glitter-aspect from H2891 taher 'be-clean' and H1305 barar 'purify'.
Root zkr. 'Remember' covers the active recalling that lies in zakar; 'recall' is more passive.
From √zachar (remember); lasting name or mention; concordantly 'remembrance'.
Proper noun, Benjamin-son Jeiel Gibeon; 1Chr 8:31; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zecher.
Root zkr (remember, H2142). Homographic noun: 'male' (memory-bearer). 'Male' preserves the gender-designation.
From √zachar (remember); deliberately lasting sign or feast of remembrance; concordantly 'memorial'.

Several persons: Levitical Korahite (Ex 6:21), Benjamites (1Chr 8:19,23,27, 9:15, 26:25, 27:16), Reubenite-prince (1Chr 27:16), Ephraimite hero (2Chr 28:7), father of Amasiah under Jehoshaphat (2Chr 17:16).
Proper noun ('YHWH-has-remembered'); prophet and several persons; concordantly transliterated.
The prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, grandson of Iddo - Ezra 5:1, 6:14, in the Aramaic context of the rebuilding; disambiguated from numerous other Zechariahs and H2148a.
When-vileness-among-men-is-exalted; Ps 12:8.
YHWH shall-prune branching-twigs before harvest; Isa 18:5.
First-sense nazal; mountains-would-flow-at-Your-presence; Isa 64:3.
Over-eating and revelry with wine-drinker (Deut 21:20; Prov 23:20,21; 28:7). Hyphenated to distinguish glutton-greedy-aspect from homonym H2151a zalal-I 'shake' and H5435 sove 'wine-drinker'.
The burning anger-wind as judgment - Psalm 11:6 (fire and brimstone and a horrible tempest shall be the portion of their cup) and 119:53 (a horror has taken hold upon me because of the wicked).
Leah's slave-concubine, mother of Gad and Asher (Gen 29:24; 30:9,10,12; 35:26; 37:2; 46:18). English convention: Zilpah.
Conscious baseness, sexually-morally abomination; concordantly 'lewdness'.
Lev-blood-relatives-incest-abomination and Eze-sword-for-shameful-deeds and Judg-shameful-deed-with-guest (Lev 18:17; 19:29; Judg 20:6; Eze 22:9). Hyphenated.

Grape-tendril or cut-off-branch (Num 13:23; Isa 17:10; Eze 8:17; 15:2; Nah 2:3). Hyphenated to distinguish branch-tendril-aspect from H5189 netishah 'tendril' and H7976 shilluchah 'shoot'; family with H2168.
Proper noun giant-people Ammon-territory; Deut 2:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zamzummim.
Sung songs for praise (2Sam 22:1; 23:1; Job 35:10; Ps 95:2; 119:54; Isa 24:16; 25:5). Hyphenated to distinguish praise-songs-aspect from H7892 shir 'song' and H4210 mizmor 'psalm'.
Singing-time has come turtle-dove heard; Song 2:12.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Becher; 1Chr 7:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zemirah.
Qal: deliberately plan, plot against someone (devise evil, YHWH had purposed); concordantly 'plot'.
Wicked's-plan-not-to-let-succeed; Ps 140:8.
Appointed-times and to-the-king-to-tell-set-time (Ezra 10:14; Neh 10:35; 13:31). Hyphenated to distinguish appoint-set-time-aspect from H6942 qadash 'sanctify-set-apart'.
Aramaic agree-prepare-together (Dan 2 lying-word-together); cognate Hebrew √zmn.
Esther-appointed-Purim-day and Ecclesiastes-everything-has-its-set-time and Nehemiah-set-times-for-offering (Esth 9:27,31; Eccl 3:1; Neh 10:35; 13:31). Hyphenated.
Aramaic 'agreed/set period'; Ezra 5:3 'how long?', Dan 2:16,21 'times change', 3:7-8 'at-that-time', 4:36, 6:10,13 'three times-times per day', 7:12,22,25 'time-times-half-time'.
Piel: play with musical instrument and sing; cult-praise; the hyphenated English marks cultic action.
Vineyard-prune-Sabbath-forbidden and vineyard-care (Lev 25:3,4; Isa 5:6). Hyphenated to distinguish prune-vine-trim-aspect from homonym H2167 zamar 'make-music-sing' (already assigned).
Clean food-species mountain-buck; Deut 14:5.
Aramaic-music-ensemble at statue-inauguration (Dan 3:5,7,10,15). Hyphenated to distinguish music-string-music-aramaic-aspect from H2172 zimrah 'song-singing' and H4210 mizmor.
Aramaic parallel to Hebrew zammar; temple-choir-singer; Ezra 7:24.
Psalm-singing for YHWH and instrument-music (Ps 81:3; 98:5; Amos 5:23; Isa 51:3). Hyphenated to distinguish song-music-aspect from H7892 shir 'song' (already assigned) and H4210 mizmor.
Second-sense zimrah; sung-noble-yield-of-land; Gen 43:11.
Proper noun ('my-praise-song'); Simeonite who was thrust through by Phinehas, king Zimri of Israel; concordantly transliterated (distinguished from zimri II tribe-name).
Proper noun, people-destined-for-Babel's-cup; Jer 25:25; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zimri.
Gen-Keturah-bore-Zimran-Jokshan-Medan-Midian-Ishbak-and-Shuah and 1Chr-sons-Keturah-Zimran (Gen 25:2; 1Chr 1:32). Hyphenated.
YHWH-my-strength-and-my-song in exodus-song and restoration-song (Ex 15:2; Ps 118:14; Isa 12:2). Hyphenated to distinguish strength-song-aspect from H2172 zimrah 'song-music'.
Ps-cattle-of-every-kind-wealth and Ecclesiastes-all-kinds-of-pleasure-gardens-Solomon (Ps 144:13; 2Chr 16:14; Eccl 2:5). Hyphenated to distinguish kind-class-variety-aspect from H4327a min 'kind'.
Aramaic-designation for 'all-kinds-of' music and all kinds of plants (Dan 3:5,7,10,15). Hyphenated to distinguish kind-sort-aramaic-aspect from H4327 min 'kind' (already assigned); Aramaic loan.
Deut-remember-what-Amalek-did-to-you-on-the-way-when-you-came-out-of-Egypt-how-he-smote-your-rear and Josh-Joshua-smote-Amalek-and-cut-off-his-rear (Deut 25:18; Josh 10:19 cf). Hyphenated.
Rear-protrusion of animal; serpent in Moses' hand (Ex 4:4), foxes-tails (Judg 15:4), metaphorically 'tail' of people = inferior role (Deut 28:13,44, Isa 9:13-14, 19:15), smoking firebrands (Isa 7:4).
Root znh. Sexual unfaithfulness, also figuratively idolatry. 'Play-the-harlot' preserves the unfaithfulness-kernel; standard concordant.
Two Judah-cities in lowland and hill-country (Josh 15:34,56; 1Chr 4:18; Neh 3:13; 11:30). English convention: Zanoah. 'Rejected-place'; family with H2186 zanach 'reject'.
Plural-abstract of zanah (play-harlot, H2181); iterative-collective acts-of-faithlessness-with-idols (Gen 38:24, Num 14:33, 2Kgs 9:22, Hos 1:2, 2:2,4, 4:12, 5:4, Eze 23:11,29, Nah 3:4).

Nominal-form of zanah (play-harlot, H2181) for abstract-idolatry-metaphor distinguished from zenunim (harlotries-plural, H2183) and taznut (harlotry-general, H8457) by nominal-abstract-aspect (Num 14:33, Jer 3:2,9, 13:27, Eze 23:27, Hos 4:11, 6:10).

1K-then-came-two-women-that-were-harlots-to-the-king and 1K-and-they-washed-his-armour-by-the-pool-of-Samaria-and-the-dogs-licked-up-his-blood-where-the-harlots-washed (1K 3:16; 1K 22:38). Hyphenated.
Qal: cast off, abandon (mostly God rejects people/person); the hyphenated English marks throwing-away.
Second-sense zanach; Nile-streams-shall-stink; Isa 19:6.
Piel; Dan leaps as young lion from Bashan; Deut 33:22.
Body-fluid through exertion; Gen 3:19.
Object-of-horror among peoples (Deut 28:25 (Ketib); Jer 15:4; 24:9; 29:18; 34:17; 2Chr 29:8; Eze 23:46). Hyphenated to distinguish horror-object-aspect from H8047 shamma 'horror' (state).
Gen-sons-Ezer-Bilhan-Zaavan-Akan and 1Chr-sons-Ezer-Bilhan-Zaavan-Jaakan (Gen 36:27; 1Chr 1:42). Hyphenated.
Small in number or quantity (Job 36:2; Isa 28:10,13; Zech 4:10). Hyphenated to distinguish little-few-aspect from H4592 me'at 'few' and H6996 qaton 'small'.
Aramaic for little-horn coming-up among-ten; Dan 7:8.
Niphal; Job's-days are extinguished; Job 17:1.
From √zʿm (utter-with-indignation); verbally condemn/curse (Num 23:7-8 Balaam), divine indignation (Ps 7:12, Mal 1:4); concordantly 'denounce' distinguishes from arar (H779 curse).
From √zaam (be-angry); fierce displeasure, judgment-wrath; concordantly 'indignation'.
Cloudy-vexed appearance show or rage (Gen 40:6; 1Kgs 20:43; 21:4; Dan 1:10; 2Chr 26:19). Hyphenated to distinguish stormy-vexed-aspect from H639 af 'anger'; family with H2197 za'af.
Violent-surging displeasure of king or God (2Chr 16:10; 28:9; Prov 19:12; Isa 30:30; Jonah 1:15; Mic 7:9). Hyphenated to distinguish stormy-displeasure-aspect from H2750 chori 'wrath'.

1K-and-the-king-of-Israel-went-to-his-house-displeased-and-angry and 1K-and-Ahab-came-to-his-house-sullen-and-angry-because-of-the-word-which-Naboth-the-Jezreelite-had-spoken-to-him (1K 20:43; 21:4). Hyphenated.
Qal: loudly call for help or in pain; distinguished from qara (call) and shaaq; concordantly 'cry-out'.
Aramaic Peal; king-cries-loud at den; Dan 6:20.
From √zaaq (cry-out); loud anguish-call for help; the hyphenated English marks distress.
Proper noun, northern border-place; Num 34:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ziphron.
Pitch-and-bitumen-at-Moses-basket and judgment-burning (Ex 2:3; Isa 34:9 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish pitch-asphalt-tar-aspect from H2564 chemar 'asphalt-bitumen' (already assigned).
Adjective/verb: come of age; noun zaqen 'elder' as office-bearer; concordantly 'old'.
Root zqn (be-old, H2204); zaqan = beard (H2206). Substantively zaqen = old-of-beard = elder/aged. 'Old' as quality; elders in context.
Face-hair as sign of adulthood; concordantly 'beard'.
Bodily state of being-old (not the old man); Jacob; Gen 48:10.
Child-born-at-grey-age (Gen 21:2,7; 37:3; 44:20). Hyphenated to distinguish old-age-offspring-aspect from H2207 zoqen 'high-age' and H2209 ziqnah 'aged-years'.
State of being-very-aged (Gen 24:36; 48:10; 1Kgs 11:4; 15:23; Ps 71:9,18; Prov 23:22; Isa 46:4). Hyphenated to distinguish age-state from H7872 seyvah 'grey-old-age' (physical-grey-hair).

The raising of the bowed - Psalm 145:14 (the LORD upholds all that fall, and raises up all those that be bowed down) and Psalm 146:8 (the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD raises them that are bowed down).
Aramaic Pael-passive; hanged-on-beam; Ezra 6:11.
Metal or wine sift to purity (1Chr 28:18; 29:4; Job 28:1; 36:27; Ps 12:7; Isa 25:6; Mal 3:3). Hyphenated to distinguish filter-purification-action from H1305 barar 'purify'.

Decorative relief-rim in gold around sacred-furniture (Ex 25:11,24-25 ark-and-table 'gold-ornamental-rim around', 30:3-4 incense-altar, 37:2,11-12,26-27 building-execution); only 10x exclusively in tabernacle.
Through-the-nose-coming-out into aversion; flesh-overdose; Num 11:20.
Pual; mountain-streams shrivel in summer; Job 6:17.
Proper noun ('born-in-Babel'); leader of first return; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic parallel to Hebrew Zerubbabel; Ezra 5:2; concordantly transliterated.
Border-river between Moab and Edom (Num 21:12; Deut 2:13 twice, 14). English convention: Zered. 'Willow-flowing'.
Qal: scatter, disperse (winnow grain, scatter peoples); concordantly 'winnow'.
Unique lexeme. Upper-arm, also figuratively 'strength'. 'Arm' covers anatomical and metonymic.
Lev-as-of-water-sprinkled-falls-on-seed-unclean and Isa-as-garden-the-sowing-causes-to-spring (Lev 11:37; Isa 61:11). Hyphenated to distinguish sown-vegetable-seed-crop-aspect from H2233 zera.
Second-sense zarzif; righteous-king-as-drops-on-earth; Ps 72:6.
Slim-girded-rooster-among-admirable-walkers; Prov 30:31.
Qal: shining come up (sun, light, leprosy); concordantly 'rise'.
Nations-to-your-light-radiance come; Isa 60:3.
Proper noun ('rising'); twin-son of Judah, also Edomite/Cushite; concordantly transliterated.
Gentilic-name of Judah's descendants (Num 26:13,20; Josh 7:17; 1Chr 27:11,13). English convention: Zerahite.
Priest-ancestor and Levitical family-head (1Chr 5:32; 6:36; Ezra 7:4; 8:4). English convention: Zerahiah. 'YHWH-has-risen'.
The sweeping-away by torrential-rain - Psalm 77:18 (the clouds poured out water) and Psalm 90:5 (You carry them away as with a flood).

Violent-short-storm-shower distinguished from H1653 geshem (downpour-long-duration) by short-violent-aspect (Job 24:8 poor-homeless 'from-storm-of-mountains they-are-drenched, and-without-shelter they-embrace-rock').
Seminal discharge or flood - in Ezekiel 23:20 (whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses) and Ezekiel 23:20-repetition; from H2229 zaram (stream, pour out).
Qal: scatter seed (literally and metaphorically); concordantly 'sow'.
Root zr' (sow, H2232). 'Seed' covers plant-seed and human descent; 'descendants' breaks concordance with plant-seed.
Aramaic seed-descendants (Dan 2:43 mingle-themselves-with-seed-of-men); cognate Hebrew H2233 zera.
First-sense zeroa; ten-day-test of sown-vegetable-eat; Dan 1:12.
Second-sense zeron; pulse-vegetable instead of king's-food; Dan 1:16.
Qal: pour out blood or water with swing, scatter over altar; concordantly 'sprinkle'.
Poel; Shunammite child sneezed seven times for resurrection; 2Kgs 4:35.
Haman's wife and counsellor in downfall (Esth 5:10,14; 6:13 twice). English convention: Zeresh. 'Gold-glitter'.
Hand-breadth-measure between thumb and little-finger spread (Ex 28:16; 39:9; 1Sam 17:4; Isa 40:12; Eze 43:13). Hyphenated to preserve spread-handspan-aspect.
Post-exilic-family-ancestor and covenant-sealer (Ezra 2:8; 8:5; 10:27; Neh 7:13; 10:14). English convention: Zattu. 'Glitter-olive'.

1Chr-the-sons-of-Laadan-Jehiel-the-first-and-Zetham-and-Joel and 1Chr-Shelomith-and-Haziel-and-Haran-three-Shelomoth-was-a-head-the-sons-of-Shimei-Jahath-Zina-and-Jeush-and-Beriah (1Chr 23:8; 26:22). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, sixth eunuch attendant of Ahasuerus; Esth 1:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Zethar.
Hapax Job 31:33 in-bosom-sin-hide; possibly variant H2436 cheq.
Niphal/Hithpael: hide oneself for danger or shame; concordantly 'hide-oneself'.
Qal-participle; peoples-cherishing-at-His-side; Deut 33:3.
Num-Moses-to-Hobab-son-Reuel-father-in-law-Moses-we-journey-to-place and Judg-children-Hobab-father-in-law-Moses-Kenite (Num 10:29; Judg 4:11). Hyphenated.
Fearful-shelter in mountains or caves (Josh 2:16; 1Sam 19:2; 2Sam 18:3; 2Kgs 6:29). Hyphenated to distinguish hide-shelter-aspect from H5641 sathar 'hide' and H2244 chava 'hide-oneself'.
Aramaic for no-harm-done against king; Dan 6:22.
Habor-river-Gozan-where-Northern-tribes-exile (2Kgs 17:6; 18:11; 1Chr 5:26). English convention: Habor. Assyrian-place-name: Khabur-river-Mesopotamia.
Bruise-stripe without open bleeding (Gen 4:23; Ex 21:25; Ps 38:6; Prov 20:30; Isa 1:6; 53:5). Hyphenated to distinguish bruised-subdermal from H6482 petsa 'open-wound' (bleeding).
Fruits or grain with stick beat-loose (Deut 24:20; Judg 6:11; Ruth 2:17; Isa 27:12). Hyphenated to distinguish stick-beat-thresh-aspect from H1758 dush 'thresh'.
Head of a priestly-family whose descent could not be proved and who were therefore excluded from the priesthood - Ezra 2:61, Nehemiah 7:63.
Hiding-of-God's-power; Hab 3:4.
Qal: hold in pledge (cloak, upper millstone), regulated in Ex 22; the hyphenated English distinguishes from chaval II 'damage', III 'have birth-pangs'.

Second homonym distinguished from chaval-I (take-pledge) and chaval-III (birth-pang); Qal/Piel: pernicious-act/bring-to-ruin (Neh 1:7 'we have heavily-corrupted-against-you', Job 17:1 spirit-undone, Eccl 5:6, Isa 13:5, 32:7, 54:16, Mic 2:10).

Ex-not-take-pledge-millstone and Deut-not-take-pledge-widow's-garment and Amos-clothes-pledged-by-every-altar (Ex 22:25; Deut 24:6,17; Amos 2:8). Hyphenated to distinguish take-pledge-aspect from chaval-I.
Aramaic-verb for destroying or causing harm (Ezra 6:12; Dan 2:44; 4:20; 6:23,27; 7:14). Hyphenated to mark Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H2254a chaval-I.
Twisted rope; metaphorically also measuring-line/inheritance; distinguished from chevel II (pangs) and chevel III (region); concordantly 'cord'.
By-measuring-line-allotted ground-portion (Deut 32:9; Josh 17:5,14; 19:9; Ps 16:6; 78:55; 105:11; Mic 2:5). Hyphenated; distinguishes allotted-portion from homonym H2256a chevel-I 'cord'.
